svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Disc 80 dia x 15 thick with a 32.6 x 8.6 slot through the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M5 thumb screw hole 5.4 dia from the edge to the slot, on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre line, 7.5 up; a slot for an M5 nut 20 mm from centre, open

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at the top, so the nut drops in and the screw threads through it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: slides on the blade; the thumb screw clamps it on the blade's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wide face, with its top face at the 485 mm mark.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In use it rests on the soil beside the 50 mm auger hole and stops the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: point at 485 mm below grade, the depth of the electrode tips.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it slides on the blade without rocking, and one finger-tight

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: turn of the thumb screw holds it under a firm pull.
